® or Genasys Evertel® (Evertel) this summer, with deployments now underway. Customers include city, county, federal, university, and tribal agencies.

“Our continued investment in the Genasys software platform is translating into growth,” said Genasys CEO, Richard Danforth. “These recent wins in California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Nebraska, New Jersey, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Texas, and Washington reflect both new and subsequent orders from our expanding customer base."

“More agencies are selecting Genasys Protect and Evertel because the technology is best in class, and every new deployment makes the platform more valuable to neighboring jurisdictions,” Mr. Danforth continued. “The momentum behind Genasys as the leading protective communications platform in the U.S. is building. Our growing pipeline includes large software opportunities with the potential to significantly extend Genasys Protect and Genasys Evertel coverage.”

Genasys Protect’s zone-based, multichannel alerting helps ensure only the people in affected areas receive incident notifications and evacuation alerts. By enabling the delivery of the right message to the right people at the right time, the use of Genasys Protect can reduce alert fatigue, build public trust, and enhance overall incident response.

Genasys Evertel provides seamless, secure, compliant collaboration for first responders and government agencies. Evertel greatly enhances communications with voice, chat, messaging, video, and images, empowering teams to share critical information and receive agency-wide and cross-agency updates in a secure, real-time environment.

Genasys is the global leader in Protective Communications®, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of preparedness, response, and analytics software and hardware solutions available. The company’s Long Range Acoustic Device® (LRAD®) and Protect Platform, which includes Genasys Protect® and Genasys Evertel®, are designed around one premise: ensuring organizations and public safety agencies are Ready when it matters®. Protecting people and saving lives for over 40 years, Genasys covers more than 155 million people in all 50 states and in over 100 countries worldwide. For more information, visit genasys.com.
